taxonomy:
Here is a simple single-depth taxonomy of the listed grid-based logic games, using 7 categories and placing each game in exactly one category.

# 1. Loop and Path Drawing
- Dotchi-Loop
- Hashiwokakero
- Masyu
- Mid-loop
- Numberlink
- Slitherlink
- Suraromu

# 2. Shading and Region Division
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Five Cells
- Heyawake
- Juosan
- LITS
- Nurikabe
- Shikaku
- Tilepaint
- Yosenabe

# 3. Object Placement and Adjacency
- Akari
- Hebi
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Makaro
- Moon-or-Sun
- Norinori
- Ripple Effect
- Sto-stone
- Usowan

# 4. Number Placement and Arithmetic-Style Grids
- Nansuke
- Sudoku

# 5. Direction, Flow, and Line Guidance
- Nagareru
- Pencils
- Sashigane
- Satogaeri
- Yajilin

# 6. Polyomino and Shape Construction
- Chained Block
- Evolomino
- Fillomino
- Shakashaka

# 7. Maze, Area, and Connectivity Variants
- Nurimeizu
- Nurimisaki
- Nuritwin
